verdict.rationale: Cooley offers legal services, the Cooley GO document generators and the firm-owned Cooley AI. A legal-tech or document platform could plausibly ship event-triggered automation, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of user-definable rules that fire actions on events. The only 'automatic' behavior is fixed conditional document inclusion, such as adding 83(b) forms when stock vests, which is built-in generator logic rather than user-defined triggers. Probes found no public API or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
